measurement: Saved optical-band electric and magnetic field energy, integrated over all saved modes with cylindrical cell areas. Parseval checked.
radius: Centroid-corrected RMS-equivalent spot radius at the peak of the longitudinal optical-energy profile; equals w for a Gaussian.
vacuum: Input Gaussian evaluated at the R8 optical-energy-profile peak position, with the configured focus and Rayleigh length.
boundary_flags: At least 1% of saved optical energy within the outer 10% of radial range or within 2 µm of a longitudinal boundary. Flags remain in laser.csv.
